WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) AS month,
    SUM(totals.totalTransactionRevenue) / 1000000 AS monthly_revenue_millions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20171231'
    AND trafficSource.source = '(direct)'
    AND totals.totalTransactionRevenue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT 
  '(direct)' AS traffic_source,
  ROUND(MAX(monthly_revenue_millions) - MIN(monthly_revenue_millions), 2) AS difference_millions
FROM monthly_revenue

WITH top_source AS (
  SELECT 
    t.trafficSource.source as traffic_source
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` t
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(t.hits) AS h
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
    AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY traffic_source
  ORDER BY SUM(p.productRevenue) DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
daily_revs AS (
  SELECT 
    MAX(daily_rev) as max_daily
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      SUM(p.productRevenue) / 1000000.0 / 1000000.0 as daily_rev
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` t
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(t.hits) AS h
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p
    WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
      AND t.trafficSource.source = (SELECT traffic_source FROM top_source)
      AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY t.date
  )
),
weekly_revs AS (
  SELECT 
    MAX(weekly_rev) as max_weekly
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      SUM(p.productRevenue) / 1000000.0 / 1000000.0 as weekly_rev
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` t
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(t.hits) AS h
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p
    WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
      AND t.trafficSource.source = (SELECT traffic_source FROM top_source)
      AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', t.date), WEEK(MONDAY))
  )
),
monthly_revs AS (
  SELECT 
    MAX(monthly_rev) as max_monthly
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      SUM(p.productRevenue) / 1000000.0 / 1000000.0 as monthly_rev
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` t
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(t.hits) AS h
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p
    WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
      AND t.trafficSource.source = (SELECT traffic_source FROM top_source)
      AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', t.date), MONTH)
  )
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT traffic_source FROM top_source) as traffic_source,
  ROUND(max_daily, 6) as max_daily_product_revenue_millions,
  ROUND(max_weekly, 6) as max_weekly_product_revenue_millions,
  ROUND(max_monthly, 6) as max_monthly_product_revenue_millions
FROM daily_revs, weekly_revs, monthly_revs

WITH first_visit AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, MIN(date) AS first_visit_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
first_transaction AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, date, visitorId, device.deviceCategory AS transaction_device_category
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
    AND totals.transactions IS NOT NULL 
    AND totals.transactions > 0
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId ORDER BY date ASC) = 1
)
SELECT ft.fullVisitorId, ft.visitorId
FROM first_visit fv
JOIN first_transaction ft ON fv.fullVisitorId = ft.fullVisitorId
WHERE ft.transaction_device_category = 'mobile'
  AND ft.date > fv.first_visit_date
ORDER BY ft.fullVisitorId

SELECT 
  nppes_provider_state AS state,
  drug_name,
  SUM(total_claim_count) AS total_prescriptions
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.part_d_prescriber_2014`
WHERE nppes_provider_state IS NOT NULL
  AND nppes_provider_state NOT IN ('AA', 'AE', 'AP', 'AS', 'GU', 'MP', 'PR', 'VI')
GROUP BY nppes_provider_state, drug_name
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY nppes_provider_state ORDER BY SUM(total_claim_count) DESC) = 1
ORDER BY state

WITH yearly_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    state,
    CAST(SUBSTR(_TABLE_SUFFIX, 1, 4) AS INT64) AS year,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '1980' AND '1995'
  GROUP BY state, year
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    state,
    year,
    event_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY event_count DESC) AS rn
  FROM yearly_counts
)
SELECT state, SUM(event_count) AS total_events
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 1000
GROUP BY state
ORDER BY total_events DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH wa_stations AS (
  SELECT usaf, wban, name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`
  WHERE state = 'WA'
),
rainy_2023 AS (
  SELECT gs.stn AS usaf, gs.wban, COUNT(*) AS rainy_days
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2023` gs
  WHERE gs.prcp > 0 AND gs.prcp != 99.99
  GROUP BY gs.stn, gs.wban
),
rainy_2022 AS (
  SELECT gs.stn AS usaf, gs.wban, COUNT(*) AS rainy_days
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2022` gs
  WHERE gs.prcp > 0 AND gs.prcp != 99.99
  GROUP BY gs.stn, gs.wban
)
SELECT ws.usaf, ws.wban, ws.name,
       r23.rainy_days AS rainy_days_2023,
       r22.rainy_days AS rainy_days_2022
FROM wa_stations ws
JOIN rainy_2023 r23 ON ws.usaf = r23.usaf AND ws.wban = r23.wban
JOIN rainy_2022 r22 ON ws.usaf = r22.usaf AND ws.wban = r22.wban
WHERE r23.rainy_days > 150
  AND r23.rainy_days < r22.rainy_days
ORDER BY r23.rainy_days DESC

WITH precip AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    value / 10.0 AS precip_mm
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_2016`
  WHERE id = 'US1NJBG0018' 
    AND element = 'PRCP' 
    AND (qflag IS NULL OR qflag = '')
),
rainy_days AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    CASE WHEN precip_mm > 5 THEN 'rainy' ELSE 'non-rainy' END AS weather_condition
  FROM precip
),
daily_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE(starttime) AS trip_date,
    COUNT(*) AS trip_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM starttime) = 2016
  GROUP BY DATE(starttime)
)
SELECT 
  rd.weather_condition,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(COALESCE(dt.trip_count, 0)), COUNT(*)), 2) AS avg_daily_trips
FROM rainy_days rd
LEFT JOIN daily_trips dt ON rd.date = dt.trip_date
GROUP BY rd.weather_condition

WITH same_station_trips AS (
    SELECT 
        start_station_id,
        start_station_name,
        end_station_id,
        end_station_name,
        starttime,
        CAST(starttime AS DATE) as trip_date,
        (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM CAST(starttime AS TIMESTAMP)) * 60 + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM CAST(starttime AS TIMESTAMP))) / 2 as twominute_bucket
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    WHERE start_station_id = end_station_id
),
group_windows AS (
    SELECT start_station_id, trip_date, twominute_bucket
    FROM same_station_trips
    GROUP BY start_station_id, trip_date, twominute_bucket
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
),
group_trips AS (
    SELECT s.start_station_id,
           s.end_station_id,
           s.end_station_name,
           CASE WHEN g.start_station_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_group
    FROM same_station_trips s
    LEFT JOIN group_windows g 
        ON s.start_station_id = g.start_station_id 
        AND s.trip_date = g.trip_date 
        AND s.twominute_bucket = g.twominute_bucket
)
SELECT 
    end_station_id as station_id,
    end_station_name as station_name,
    SUM(is_group) as group_trips,
    COUNT(*) as total_trips,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(is_group), COUNT(*)) as group_proportion
FROM group_trips
GROUP BY end_station_id, end_station_name
ORDER BY group_proportion DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH top_20_bike_routes AS (
    SELECT 
        start_station_name,
        end_station_name,
        ROUND(start_station_latitude, 3) as start_lat,
        ROUND(start_station_longitude, 3) as start_lon,
        ROUND(end_station_latitude, 3) as end_lat,
        ROUND(end_station_longitude, 3) as end_lon,
        COUNT(*) as trip_count,
        AVG(tripduration) as avg_bike_duration
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM starttime) = 2016
        AND tripduration > 0
    GROUP BY start_station_name, end_station_name, start_station_latitude, start_station_longitude, end_station_latitude, end_station_longitude
    ORDER BY trip_count DESC
    LIMIT 20
),
taxi_durations AS (
    SELECT 
        ROUND(pickup_latitude, 3) as start_lat,
        ROUND(pickup_longitude, 3) as start_lon,
        ROUND(dropoff_latitude, 3) as end_lat,
        ROUND(dropoff_longitude, 3) as end_lon,
        AVG(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(dropoff_datetime, pickup_datetime, SECOND)) as avg_taxi_duration
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2016`
    WHERE dropoff_datetime IS NOT NULL 
        AND pickup_datetime IS NOT NULL
        AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(dropoff_datetime, pickup_datetime, SECOND) > 0
        AND pickup_latitude IS NOT NULL AND pickup_longitude IS NOT NULL
        AND dropoff_latitude IS NOT NULL AND dropoff_longitude IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY start_lat, start_lon, end_lat, end_lon
),
faster_routes AS (
    SELECT 
        br.start_station_name,
        br.end_station_name,
        br.trip_count,
        br.avg_bike_duration,
        td.avg_taxi_duration
    FROM top_20_bike_routes br
    JOIN taxi_durations td 
        ON br.start_lat = td.start_lat 
        AND br.start_lon = td.start_lon
        AND br.end_lat = td.end_lat
        AND br.end_lon = td.end_lon
    WHERE br.avg_bike_duration < td.avg_taxi_duration
)
SELECT 
    start_station_name,
    end_station_name,
    ROUND(avg_bike_duration, 2) as avg_bike_duration
FROM faster_routes
ORDER BY avg_bike_duration DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH filtered_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    t1.pickup_location_id,
    tz.borough as pickup_borough,
    CASE 
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(t1.tip_amount * 100, t1.total_amount) = 0 THEN 1 
      ELSE 0 
    END as is_no_tip
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016` t1
  LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` tz
    ON t1.pickup_location_id = tz.zone_id
  WHERE t1.pickup_datetime >= TIMESTAMP('2016-01-01 00:00:00')
    AND t1.pickup_datetime < TIMESTAMP('2016-01-08 00:00:00')
    AND t1.dropoff_datetime > t1.pickup_datetime
    AND t1.passenger_count > 0
    AND t1.trip_distance >= 0
    AND t1.tip_amount >= 0
    AND t1.tolls_amount >= 0
    AND t1.mta_tax >= 0
    AND t1.fare_amount >= 0
    AND t1.total_amount >= 0
),
borough_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    pickup_borough,
    COUNT(*) as total_trips,
    SUM(is_no_tip) as no_tip_trips
  FROM filtered_trips
  WHERE pickup_borough IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY pickup_borough
)
SELECT 
  pickup_borough,
  total_trips,
  no_tip_trips,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(no_tip_trips * 100, total_trips) as no_tip_percentage
FROM borough_stats
ORDER BY pickup_borough

WITH station_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    borough_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT station_id) AS total_stations
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_subway.stations`
  GROUP BY borough_name
),
ada_entry_stations AS (
  SELECT 
    s.borough_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.station_id) AS ada_entry_stations
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_subway.stations` s
  INNER JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_subway.station_entrances` e
    ON s.station_name = e.station_name
    AND s.station_lat = e.station_lat
    AND s.station_lon = e.station_lon
  WHERE e.entry = TRUE AND e.ada_compliant = TRUE
  GROUP BY s.borough_name
)
SELECT 
  sc.borough_name,
  sc.total_stations,
  COALESCE(aes.ada_entry_stations, 0) AS ada_entry_stations,
  ROUND(COALESCE(aes.ada_entry_stations, 0) * 100.0 / sc.total_stations, 2) AS percentage
FROM station_counts sc
LEFT JOIN ada_entry_stations aes
  ON sc.borough_name = aes.borough_name
ORDER BY percentage DESC

WITH trip_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y%m', start_date) AS year_month,
    duration_sec / 60.0 AS duration_min,
    start_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y%m', start_date) ORDER BY start_date ASC) AS rn_first,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y%m', start_date) ORDER BY start_date DESC) AS rn_last
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_trips`
),
first_last AS (
  SELECT
    year_month,
    MIN(CASE WHEN rn_first = 1 THEN duration_min END) AS first_duration_min,
    MIN(CASE WHEN rn_last = 1 THEN duration_min END) AS last_duration_min
  FROM trip_ranked
  GROUP BY year_month
),
min_max AS (
  SELECT
    FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y%m', start_date) AS year_month,
    MIN(duration_sec / 60.0) AS lowest_duration_min,
    MAX(duration_sec / 60.0) AS highest_duration_min
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_trips`
  GROUP BY year_month
)
SELECT
  fl.year_month,
  fl.first_duration_min,
  fl.last_duration_min,
  mm.highest_duration_min,
  mm.lowest_duration_min
FROM first_last fl
JOIN min_max mm ON fl.year_month = mm.year_month
ORDER BY fl.year_month

SELECT 
    r.name AS region_name,
    t.trip_id,
    t.duration_sec,
    t.start_date,
    t.start_station_name,
    t.member_gender
FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips` t
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_station_info` s
    ON t.start_station_id = CAST(s.station_id AS INT64)
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_regions` r
    ON s.region_id = r.region_id
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.start_date) BETWEEN 2014 AND 2017
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.name ORDER BY t.start_date DESC) = 1

WITH bike_counts AS (
  SELECT b.neighborhood, COUNT(*) as bike_station_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_station_info` s
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_neighborhoods.boundaries` b
    ON ST_CONTAINS(b.neighborhood_geom, s.station_geom)
  GROUP BY b.neighborhood
),
crime_counts AS (
  SELECT b.neighborhood, COUNT(*) as crime_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_sfpd_incidents.sfpd_incidents` i
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_neighborhoods.boundaries` b
    ON ST_CONTAINS(b.neighborhood_geom, ST_GEOGPOINT(i.longitude, i.latitude))
  GROUP BY b.neighborhood
)
SELECT 
  b.neighborhood,
  b.bike_station_count,
  c.crime_count
FROM bike_counts b
JOIN crime_counts c
  ON b.neighborhood = c.neighborhood
ORDER BY b.neighborhood

SELECT country_name, SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN age < 25 THEN population ELSE 0 END), SUM(population)) * 100 AS pct_under_25 FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.midyear_population_agespecific` WHERE year = 2017 GROUP BY country_name ORDER BY pct_under_25 DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT country_name, 
       cumulative_confirmed, 
       cumulative_recovered,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(cumulative_recovered, cumulative_confirmed) * 100, 2) as recovery_rate_pct
FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data`
WHERE date = '2020-05-10' AND aggregation_level = 0 
  AND cumulative_confirmed > 50000
  AND cumulative_recovered IS NOT NULL
  AND cumulative_recovered <= cumulative_confirmed
ORDER BY recovery_rate_pct DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT \n  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT facility_place_id) FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_vaccination_access.facility_boundary_us_all` WHERE facility_sub_region_1 = 'California') * 1000.0 / \n  (SELECT SUM(total_pop) FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2018_5yr` WHERE geo_id LIKE '06%') as vaccine_sites_per_1000_people

SELECT b.country_name, b.net_migration
FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.birth_death_growth_rates` b
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.country_names_area` a
  ON b.country_code = a.country_code
WHERE b.year = 2017
  AND a.country_area > 500
ORDER BY b.net_migration DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH historical_games AS (
  SELECT 
    season,
    REPLACE(win_school_ncaa, 'Mt. St. Mary', 'Mount St. Mary') AS team,
    REPLACE(lose_school_ncaa, 'Mt. St. Mary', 'Mount St. Mary') AS opponent,
    win_seed AS seed,
    lose_seed AS opponent_seed,
    win_pts AS points,
    lose_pts AS opponent_points,
    'win' AS label
  FROM `data-to-insights.ncaa.mbb_historical_tournament_games`
  WHERE season >= 2014
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    season,
    REPLACE(lose_school_ncaa, 'Mt. St. Mary', 'Mount St. Mary') AS team,
    REPLACE(win_school_ncaa, 'Mt. St. Mary', 'Mount St. Mary') AS opponent,
    lose_seed AS seed,
    win_seed AS opponent_seed,
    lose_pts AS points,
    win_pts AS opponent_points,
    'loss' AS label
  FROM `data-to-insights.ncaa.mbb_historical_tournament_games`
  WHERE season >= 2014
),
tournament_2018 AS (
  SELECT 
    season,
    CASE WHEN school_ncaa = 'UNCG' THEN 'UNC Greensboro' ELSE school_ncaa END AS team,
    CASE WHEN opponent_school_ncaa = 'UNCG' THEN 'UNC Greensboro' ELSE opponent_school_ncaa END AS opponent,
    seed,
    opponent_seed,
    points,
    opponent_points,
    label
  FROM `data-to-insights.ncaa.2018_tournament_results`
),
combined AS (
  SELECT * FROM historical_games
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM tournament_2018
)
SELECT 
  c.season,
  c.label,
  c.seed,
  c.team AS school_ncaa,
  c.opponent_seed,
  c.opponent AS opponent_school_ncaa,
  fe.pace_rank,
  fe.poss_40min,
  fe.pace_rating,
  fe.efficiency_rank,
  fe.pts_100poss,
  fe.efficiency_rating,
  fe_opp.pace_rank AS opp_pace_rank,
  fe_opp.poss_40min AS opp_poss_40min,
  fe_opp.pace_rating AS opp_pace_rating,
  fe_opp.efficiency_rank AS opp_efficiency_rank,
  fe_opp.pts_100poss AS opp_pts_100poss,
  fe_opp.efficiency_rating AS opp_efficiency_rating,
  fe_opp.pace_rank - fe.pace_rank AS pace_rank_diff,
  fe_opp.poss_40min - fe.poss_40min AS pace_stat_diff,
  fe_opp.pace_rating - fe.pace_rating AS pace_rating_diff,
  fe_opp.efficiency_rank - fe.efficiency_rank AS eff_rank_diff,
  fe_opp.pts_100poss - fe.pts_100poss AS eff_stat_diff,
  fe_opp.efficiency_rating - fe.efficiency_rating AS eff_rating_diff
FROM combined c
LEFT JOIN `data-to-insights.ncaa.feature_engineering` fe 
  ON c.team = fe.team AND c.season = fe.season
LEFT JOIN `data-to-insights.ncaa.feature_engineering` fe_opp 
  ON c.opponent = fe_opp.team AND c.season = fe_opp.season
ORDER BY season, label, school_ncaa
LIMIT 50

SELECT 
  'Asian' AS demographic_group,
  ROUND(race_asian, 3) AS value_2014,
  ROUND((SELECT race_asian FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_representation` WHERE workforce = 'overall' AND report_year = 2022), 3) AS value_2022,
  ROUND(((SELECT race_asian FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_representation` WHERE workforce = 'overall' AND report_year = 2022) - race_asian), 3) AS growth_rate_pct_points
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_representation`
WHERE workforce = 'overall' AND report_year = 2014

UNION ALL

SELECT 
  'Black' AS demographic_group,
  ROUND(race_black, 3),
  ROUND((SELECT race_black FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_representation` WHERE workforce = 'overall' AND report_year = 2022), 3),
  ROUND(((SELECT race_black FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_representation` WHERE workforce = 'overall' AND report_year = 2022) - race_black), 3)
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_representation`
WHERE workforce = 'overall' AND report_year = 2014

UNION ALL

SELECT 
  'Latinx' AS demographic_group,
  ROUND(race_hispanic_latinx, 3),
  ROUND((SELECT race_hispanic_latinx FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_representation` WHERE workforce = 'overall' AND report_year = 2022), 3),
  ROUND(((SELECT race_hispanic_latinx FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_representation` WHERE workforce = 'overall' AND report_year = 2022) - race_hispanic_latinx), 3)
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_representation`
WHERE workforce = 'overall' AND report_year = 2014

UNION ALL

SELECT 
  'Native American' AS demographic_group,
  ROUND(race_native_american, 3),
  ROUND((SELECT race_native_american FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_representation` WHERE workforce = 'overall' AND report_year = 2022), 3),
  ROUND(((SELECT race_native_american FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_representation` WHERE workforce = 'overall' AND report_year = 2022) - race_native_american), 3)
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_representation`
WHERE workforce = 'overall' AND report_year = 2014

UNION ALL

SELECT 
  'White' AS demographic_group,
  ROUND(race_white, 3),
  ROUND((SELECT race_white FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_representation` WHERE workforce = 'overall' AND report_year = 2022), 3),
  ROUND(((SELECT race_white FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_representation` WHERE workforce = 'overall' AND report_year = 2022) - race_white), 3)
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_representation`
WHERE workforce = 'overall' AND report_year = 2014

UNION ALL

SELECT 
  'US women' AS demographic_group,

SELECT

  a.comment_count AS answer_comment_count,
  q.tags AS question_tags,
  q.score AS question_score,
  q.answer_count AS question_answer_count,
  q_owner.reputation AS asker_reputation,
  q.view_count AS question_view_count,
  q.comment_count AS question_comment_count
FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q ON a.id = q.accepted_answer_id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users` a_owner ON a.owner_user_id = a_owner.id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users` q_owner ON q.owner_user_id = q_owner.id
WHERE q.creation_date >= '2016-01-01' AND q.creation_date < '2016-02-01'
  AND a.creation_date >= '2016-01-01' AND a.creation_date < '2016-02-01'
  AND q.tags LIKE '%javascript%'
  AND (q.tags LIKE '%xss%' OR q.tags LIKE '%cross-site%' OR q.tags LIKE '%exploit%' OR q.tags LIKE '%cybersecurity%')
  AND q.accepted_answer_id IS NOT NULL

WITH user_answers AS (
  SELECT 
    pa.id AS answer_id,
    pa.parent_id AS question_id,
    pa.creation_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` pa
  WHERE pa.owner_user_id = 1908967
    AND pa.creation_date < TIMESTAMP('2018-06-07')
),
answer_votes AS (
  SELECT 
    va.post_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN va.vote_type_id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes,
    SUM(CASE WHEN va.vote_type_id = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS accepted
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.votes` va
  WHERE va.post_id IN (SELECT answer_id FROM user_answers)
  GROUP BY va.post_id
),
answer_tags AS (
  SELECT 
    ua.answer_id,
    pq.tags
  FROM user_answers ua
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` pq
    ON ua.question_id = pq.id
)
SELECT 
  tag,
  SUM(10 * upvotes + 15 * accepted) AS total_score
FROM answer_tags,
UNNEST(SPLIT(tags, '|')) AS tag
LEFT JOIN answer_votes av ON answer_tags.answer_id = av.post_id
GROUP BY tag
ORDER BY total_score DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH chr13_loss AS (

  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted`
  WHERE Chr = 'chr13' 
    AND Type = 'Loss'
    AND Start <= 48481890
    AND `End` >= 48303751
),
chr17_loss AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, ChrOrd, Start, `End`,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) as rn
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted`
  WHERE Chr = 'chr17' 
    AND Type = 'Loss'
    AND Start <= 7687490
    AND `End` >= 7668421
),
chr11_gain AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, ChrOrd, Start, `End`,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) as rn
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted`
  WHERE Chr = 'chr11' 
    AND Type = 'Gain'
    AND Start <= 108369102
    AND `End` >= 108223067
),
matching_clones AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c13.RefNo, c13.CaseNo, c13.InvNo, c13.Clone
  FROM chr13_loss c13
  INNER JOIN chr17_loss c17 ON c13.RefNo = c17.RefNo AND c13.CaseNo = c17.CaseNo AND c13.InvNo = c17.InvNo AND c13.Clone = c17.Clone
  INNER JOIN chr11_gain c11 ON c13.RefNo = c11.RefNo AND c13.CaseNo = c11.CaseNo AND c13.InvNo = c11.InvNo AND c13.Clone = c11.Clone
)
SELECT 
  mc.RefNo AS CaseReference,
  mc.CaseNo AS CaseNumber,
  mc.InvNo AS InvestigationNumber,
  mc.Clone AS CloneNumber,
  c13.ChrOrd AS chr13_ChroOrd,
  c13.Start AS chr13_Start,
  c13.`End` AS chr13_End,
  c17.ChrOrd AS chr17_ChroOrd,
  c17.Start AS chr17_Start,
  c17.`End` AS chr17_End,
  c11.ChrOrd AS chr11_ChroOrd,
  c11.Start AS chr11_Start,
  c11.`End` AS chr11_End,
  kc.CloneShort AS KaryClone_Short
FROM matching_clones mc
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM chr13_loss WHERE rn = 1) c13 
  ON mc.RefNo = c13.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c13.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c13.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c13.Clone
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM chr17_loss WHERE rn = 1) c17 
  ON mc.RefNo = c17.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c17.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c17.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c17.Clone
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM chr11_gain WHERE rn = 1) c11 
  ON mc.RefNo = c11.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c11.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c11.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c11.Clone
LEFT JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.KaryClone` kc 
  ON mc.RefNo = kc.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = kc.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = kc.InvNo AND mc.Clone = kc.CloneNo
ORDER BY mc.RefNo, mc.CaseNo, mc.InvNo, mc.Clone

WITH heavy_molecules AS (
  SELECT molregno, CAST(heavy_atoms AS INT64) as heavy_atoms
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.compound_properties_29`
  WHERE CAST(heavy_atoms AS INT64) BETWEEN 10 AND 15
),
filtered_activities AS (
  SELECT a.activity_id, a.assay_id, a.doc_id, a.molregno, a.standard_value, a.standard_type,
         a.standard_relation, a.pchembl_value, a.potential_duplicate, hm.heavy_atoms
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.activities_29` a
  JOIN heavy_molecules hm ON a.molregno = hm.molregno
  WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value != ''
    AND CAST(a.pchembl_value AS FLOAT64) > 10
),
activity_counts AS (
  SELECT molregno, assay_id, COUNT(*) as act_count,
         SUM(CASE WHEN potential_duplicate = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as dup_count
  FROM filtered_activities
  GROUP BY molregno, assay_id
),
valid_activities AS (
  SELECT fa.activity_id, fa.assay_id, fa.doc_id, fa.molregno, fa.standard_value, fa.standard_type,
         fa.standard_relation, fa.heavy_atoms
  FROM filtered_activities fa
  JOIN activity_counts ac ON fa.molregno = ac.molregno AND fa.assay_id = ac.assay_id
  WHERE ac.act_count < 5 AND ac.dup_count < 2
),
rep_activities AS (
  SELECT activity_id, assay_id, doc_id, molregno, standard_value, standard_type,
         standard_relation, heavy_atoms,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY molregno, assay_id, standard_type ORDER BY activity_id) as rn
  FROM valid_activities
),
rep AS (
  SELECT activity_id, assay_id, doc_id, molregno, standard_value, standard_type,
         standard_relation, heavy_atoms
  FROM rep_activities
  WHERE rn = 1
),
pair_data AS (
  SELECT 
    r1.molregno as molregno_1,
    r2.molregno as molregno_2,
    r1.assay_id,
    r1.standard_type,
    r1.activity_id as activity_id_1,
    r2.activity_id as activity_id_2,
    SAFE_CAST(r1.standard_value AS FLOAT64) as sv1,
    SAFE_CAST(r2.standard_value AS FLOAT64) as sv2,
    r1.standard_relation as sr1,
    r2.standard_relation as sr2,
    r1.doc_id as doc_id_1,
    r2.doc_id as doc_id_2,
    GREATEST(r1.heavy_atoms, r2.heavy_atoms) as max_heavy_atoms
  FROM rep r1
  JOIN rep r2 
    ON r1.assay_id = r2.assay_id 
    AND r1.standard_type = r2.standard_type
    AND r1.molregno < r2.molregno
),
pair_doc_ids AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT doc_id_1 as doc_id FROM pair_data
  UNION DISTINCT
  SELECT DISTINCT doc_id_2 as doc_id FROM pair_data
),
pair_docs AS (
  SELECT d.doc_id, d.journal, SAFE_CAST(d.year AS INT64) as yr, SAFE_CAST(d.first_page AS INT64) as fp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.docs_29` d
  JOIN pair_doc_ids pdi ON d.doc_id = pdi.doc_id
),
doc_ranked AS (
  SELECT doc_id, journal, yr, fp,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY journal, yr ORDER BY fp) as rn,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY journal, yr) as cnt
  FROM pair_docs
),
doc_dates AS (
  SELECT doc_id,
    COALESCE(yr, 1970) as pub_year,
    CAST(LEAST(COALESCE(FLOOR(CASE WHEN cnt > 1 THEN (rn - 1) * 1.0 / (cnt - 1) ELSE 0 END * 11) + 1, 12), 12) AS INT64) as pub_month,
    COALESCE(MOD(CAST(FLOOR(CASE WHEN cnt > 1 THEN (rn - 1) * 1.0 / (cnt - 1) ELSE 0 END * 308) AS INT64), 28) + 1, 1) as pub_day
  FROM doc_ranked
),
classified AS (
  SELECT pd.*,
    CASE 
      WHEN sv1 > sv2 THEN 'decrease'
      WHEN sv1 < sv2 THEN 'increase'
      WHEN sv1 = sv2 THEN 'no-change'
      ELSE 'unknown'
    END as change_type
  FROM pair_data pd
),
with_dates AS (
  SELECT c.*,
    dd1.pub_year as pub_year_1, dd1.pub_month as pub_month_1, dd1.pub_day as pub_day_1,
    dd2.pub_year as pub_year_2, dd2.pub_month as pub_month_2, dd2.pub_day as pub_day_2
  FROM classified c
  LEFT JOIN doc_dates dd1 ON c.doc_id_1 = dd1.doc_id
  LEFT JOIN doc_dates dd2 ON c.doc_id_2 = dd2.doc_id
),
latest AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE 
      WHEN pub_year_1 > pub_year_2 THEN CONCAT(CAST(pub_year_1 AS STRING), '-', LPAD(CAST(pub_month_1 AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(pub_day_1 AS STRING), 2, '0'))
      WHEN pub_year_1 < pub_year_2 THEN CONCAT(CAST(pub_year_2 AS STRING), '-', LPAD(CAST(pub_month_2 AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(pub_day_2 AS STRING), 2, '0'))
      WHEN pub_month_1 > pub_month_2 THEN CONCAT(CAST(pub_year_1 AS STRING), '-', LPAD(CAST(pub_month_1 AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(pub_day_1 AS STRING), 2, '0'))
      WHEN pub_month_1 < pub_month_2 THEN CONCAT(CAST(pub_year_2 AS STRING), '-', LPAD(CAST(pub_month_2 AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(pub_day_2 AS STRING), 2, '0'))
      WHEN pub_day_1 >= pub_day_2 THEN CONCAT(CAST(pub_year_1 AS STRING), '-', LPAD(CAST(pub_month_1 AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(pub_day_1 AS STRING), 2, '0'))
      ELSE CONCAT(CAST(pub_year_2 AS STRING), '-', LPAD(CAST(pub_month_2 AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(pub_day_2 AS STRING), 2, '0'))
    END as latest_pub_date,
    GREATEST(doc_id_1, doc_id_2) as highest_doc_id,
    TO_HEX(MD5(TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(activity_id_1 AS A, activity_id_2 AS B)))) as mmp_delta_uuid
  FROM with_dates
)
SELECT molregno_1, molregno_2, assay_id, standard_type, max_heavy_atoms,
  latest_pub_date, highest_doc_id, change_type, mmp_delta_uuid
FROM latest
ORDER BY molregno_1, molregno_2

WITH user_months AS (

    DATE_TRUNC(DATE(timestamp), MONTH) as activity_month
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.hacker_news.full`
  WHERE timestamp <= '2024-09-10' AND `by` IS NOT NULL AND `by` != ''
  GROUP BY `by`, activity_month
),
user_first_last AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    MIN(activity_month) as first_month,
    MAX(activity_month) as last_month,
    COUNT(*) as num_active_months
  FROM user_months
  GROUP BY user_id
),
user_span AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    first_month,
    last_month,
    num_active_months,
    DATE_DIFF(last_month, first_month, MONTH) + 1 as total_months_in_span,
    (DATE_DIFF(last_month, first_month, MONTH) + 1) - num_active_months as num_gaps
  FROM user_first_last
),
user_month_spans AS (
  SELECT 
    u.user_id,
    u.first_month,
    DATE_ADD(u.first_month, INTERVAL n MONTH) as expected_month,
    DATE_DIFF(DATE_ADD(u.first_month, INTERVAL n MONTH), u.first_month, MONTH) + 1 as month_number
  FROM user_span u
  JOIN UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(0, DATE_DIFF(u.last_month, u.first_month, MONTH))) as n
),
user_gaps AS (
  SELECT 
    ums.user_id,
    ums.month_number
  FROM user_month_spans ums
  LEFT JOIN user_months um 
    ON ums.user_id = um.user_id AND ums.expected_month = um.activity_month
  WHERE um.user_id IS NULL
),
user_max_gaps AS (
  SELECT user_id, MAX(month_number) as highest_gap_month
  FROM user_gaps
  GROUP BY user_id
)

    (LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 6, segments[OFFSET(5)], '')) LIKE '%accessories%'
     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 6, segments[OFFSET(5)], '')) LIKE '%apparel%'
     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 6, segments[OFFSET(5)], '')) LIKE '%brands%'

     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 6, segments[OFFSET(5)], '')) LIKE '%google+redesign%'
     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 6, segments[OFFSET(5)], '')) LIKE '%lifestyle%'
     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 6, segments[OFFSET(5)], '')) LIKE '%nest%'
     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 6, segments[OFFSET(5)], '')) LIKE '%new+2015+logo%'
     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 6, segments[OFFSET(5)], '')) LIKE '%notebooks+journals%'
     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 6, segments[OFFSET(5)], '')) LIKE '%office%'
     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 6, segments[OFFSET(5)], '')) LIKE '%shop+by+brand%'
     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 6, segments[OFFSET(5)], '')) LIKE '%small+goods%'
     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 6, segments[OFFSET(5)], '')) LIKE '%stationery%'
     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 6, segments[OFFSET(5)], '')) LIKE '%wearables%') AS seg5_has_category,
    IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 5, INSTR(segments[OFFSET(4)], '+') > 0, FALSE) AS seg4_has_plus,
    IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 6, INSTR(segments[OFFSET(5)], '+') > 0, FALSE) AS seg5_has_plus,
    IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 1, INSTR(segments[OFFSET(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments)-1)], '+') > 0, FALSE) AS last_has_plus
  FROM parsed
)
SELECT

  CASE
    WHEN num_segments >= 5 
      AND (seg4_has_category OR seg5_has_category)
      AND INSTR(last_seg, '+') > 0
    THEN 'PDP'
    WHEN num_segments >= 5
      AND (seg4_has_category OR seg5_has_category)
      AND NOT seg4_has_plus
      AND NOT seg5_has_plus
    THEN 'PLP'
    ELSE page_title
  END AS page_type

-- Find the cohort with the highest 4th week retention rate
WITH first_sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', event_date)) AS first_session_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE event_name = 'session_start'
    AND event_date >= '20180702'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
cohort_weeks AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    first_session_date,
    DATE_SUB(first_session_date, INTERVAL MOD(EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM first_session_date) - 2 + 7, 7) DAY) AS cohort_monday
  FROM first_sessions
),
user_events AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', event_date) AS event_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE event_name = 'session_start'
),
retention AS (
  SELECT 
    cw.cohort_monday,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cw.user_pseudo_id) AS cohort_size,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN ue.event_date >= DATE_ADD(cw.cohort_monday, INTERVAL 21 DAY)
          AND ue.event_date < DATE_ADD(cw.cohort_monday, INTERVAL 28 DAY)
        THEN cw.user_pseudo_id 
      END),
      COUNT(DISTINCT cw.user_pseudo_id)
    ) AS retention_rate
  FROM cohort_weeks cw
  LEFT JOIN user_events ue 
    ON cw.user_pseudo_id = ue.user_pseudo_id
  GROUP BY cw.cohort_monday
)
SELECT cohort_monday
FROM retention
ORDER BY retention_rate DESC
LIMIT 1
